SIKACONTROL® PLUS: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaControl® PLUS, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/f/sikacontrol_plus.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaControl® PLUS where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaControl® PLUS is a shrinkage-reducing admixture used to produce high performance concrete with greatly reduced drying shrinkage.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - In premixed and precast concrete elements to reduce the drying shrinkage of the concrete.
    - In thin bonded topping slabs, to minimise the difference in shrinkage between the new topping and the existing substrate.
    - In concrete elements which are restrained against shrinkage.
    - For durable concrete in marine environments.
    - For watertight concrete in reservoirs, sewage treatment plants, dams.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaControl® PLUS
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Shrinkage-Reducing Admixture
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. SikaControl® PLUS meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 as Special Purpose Admixture Type (SN).
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Reduced drying shrinkage.
    - Reduction in the potential for drying shrinkage cracking.
    - Reduces the potential for slab curling.
    - Substantially reduces the occurrence of drying shrinkage cracks and therefore reduces permeability, resulting in improved concrete durability.
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Liquid hydroxyl combinations
    - Appearance and colour: Colourless liquid
    - Specific gravity: 0.98 g/cm³
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 litre IBC; 205 litre drum; 10 litre container
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight , shelf life is at least one (1) year.
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperature between 5°C and 35°C, protected from direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Recommended dosage. Typical dosage rate is 1.0 – 3.0% by weight of total cementitious material. Optimum dosage depends on specified requirements, mix ingredients and required plastic and hardened properties. Laboratory and/or field trials are essential in determining the optimum dosage.
4.3 Dispensing. The required dosage of SikaControl® PLUS should be added to the concrete at the batching plant, with the gauging water or poured into the concrete simultaneously with the gauging water. It may also be added into the transit mixer at the point of discharge, but an additional mixing time of 60 seconds/m³ is required and the concrete should be visually checked for uniform consistency.
4.4 Compatibility. SikaControl® PLUS is compatible with other Sika Concrete admixtures, however, they must be added separately. Do not pre-mix SikaControl® PLUS with other admixtures, and always conduct trials to test compatibility.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - When using SikaControl® PLUS, plant and site trials are always recommended to verify the performance and handling characteristics of the design concrete mix.
    - SikaControl® PLUS will reduce drying shrinkage. It will not eliminate cracking. The reduction of cracking is dependant on good engineering design, that allows for concrete shrinkage by incorporating well designed and properly located shrinkage control joints.
    - It is essential to protect the concrete from water evaporation during the crucial early age period. We recommend the use of Sika® Film evaporation retardant and Antisol curing compounds for this purpose. Refer to the Technical Data Sheets for information.
4.6 Further information. May retard concrete at lower temperatures

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaControl® PLUS, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/f/sikacontrol_plus.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaControl Plus, version 21/07/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/MSDS%20SikaControl%C2%AE%20PLUS%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® Control® PLUS, version 29/09/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sds-sika-controlplus.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
